title: Open direct-image finiteness over a regular base of dimension at most one
statement: Let $S$ be a Noetherian regular scheme [def-weil-regular-scheme] with Krull dimension at most one [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Let $\ell$ be a prime invertible in every local ring of $S$, put $A=\mathbf F_\ell$, and let $T\to S$ be separated of finite type [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. For any open immersion $j:V\hookrightarrow T$ [def-weil-open-immersion] and any constructible sheaf $F$ of modules over the constant sheaf $A_V$ on the ordinary small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], every higher direct image $R^qj_*F$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], $q\geq0$, is a constructible $A_T$-module sheaf, and there is an integer $c_F\geq0$ such that $R^qj_*F=0$ for $q>c_F$. The bound may depend on $F$; no bound for arbitrary nonconstructible sheaves is asserted. No excellence, dualizing-complex, or purity hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Expose XIII, Theorem 2.3.1(i), printed p.197, for dimension-one bases, applied to f=j and n=ell. Dimension-zero bases are covered by replacing S by the disjoint union S ⊔ Spec Q[t], of dimension one, and using the same j. Also stated directly for the regular dimension-at-most-one case by Zheng, literature/zheng-six-operations-lefschetz-verdier-DM-stacks_arXiv-1006.3810.pdf, Proposition 3.16(1), printed p.19, before Construction 3.17.

from.place: Proof Step 1, dimension-normalized Verdier duality, via the regular finite-torsion duality input: the local biduality invoked in ILO Expose XVI, Lemma 3.5.9 proof, printed p.250, before the purity of the target is proved. Here: constructibility of the biduality cone before the dimension-one projective-line induction. Specifically: the open direct-image finiteness input in the Noetherian open/closed devissage proving low-base internal-Hom finiteness.
